faq.q: How do credits work on a Black Friday ad?
faq.a: A photo spends 24 credits. A video spends 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. The cost is on screen before the job runs. If it fails, those credits return.

faq.q: Can I add sale-day music and pictures?
faq.a: Yes. Pick a track from the music library, choose visuals that fit the deal, and add captions in the editor. Use music you are allowed to play.

faq.q: Can I make sale ads for many products together?
faq.a: Yes. Run several product links and each one comes back as its own ad. You still review every file before it is published.

faq.q: Can an AI avatar deliver the sale message?
faq.a: Yes. An AI avatar can stand beside the product and say the offer, with the product kept large enough to recognize.

faq.q: What happens to the ad after Black Friday?
faq.a: You keep the file. Change the offer line, the voice, or the caption and use the same scene for Cyber Monday.

faq.q: How early should I prepare the sale creative?
faq.a: Before the offer is final. Get the avatar and the script ready from the product link, then type the discount, the code, and the end date when they are set.

faq.q: Can the ad start from a product link?
faq.a: Yes. Open the listing that will go on sale and use its photo as the scene. If that photo cuts the product off, upload the full shot you already use on the page.

faq.q: Can I publish my Black Friday video to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook?
faq.a: Yes. Download the file when it looks right, or send it to the feed you already use. It stays in your account until you share it.

faq.q: Do I need a separate file for each placement?
faq.a: Yes. Each video frame is its own run: tall 9:16, square 1:1, wide 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4. A product photo stays square.

faq.q: Can I put an end time on the sale ad?
faq.a: Yes. Set it in the editor and move it later if you need to. It stays off the product picture, so a new deadline can keep the same scene.

faq.q: Can shop tools request an ad if the API is not a separate product?
faq.a: The API is not a second login. Your tools can ask for a sale ad from a product link. You approve the file before anyone else sees it.
